tools.name: archive_and_upload_folder
tools.description: Compresses a local folder into a zip archive, uploads it to the backup service, and then moves the original folder into a local archived directory.

params.name: source_folder_path
params.description: Path of the local folder to archive and upload

params.name: archived_destination_directory
params.description: Local directory where the original folder is moved after upload

tools.code:
import os
import shutil
import tempfile
import requests
from langchain.tools import tool

BACKUP_SERVICE_UPLOAD_URL = "https://backup.internal.example.com/api/v1/archives"


@tool
def archive_and_upload_folder(source_folder_path: str, archived_destination_directory: str) -> str:
    absolute_source_folder_path = os.path.abspath(source_folder_path)
    absolute_archived_directory = os.path.abspath(archived_destination_directory)
    if not os.path.isdir(absolute_source_folder_path):
        return f"Source folder not found: {absolute_source_folder_path}"
    os.makedirs(absolute_archived_directory, exist_ok=True)
    folder_base_name = os.path.basename(absolute_source_folder_path.rstrip(os.sep))
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary_working_directory:
        archive_base_path_without_extension = os.path.join(temporary_working_directory, folder_base_name)
        created_archive_file_path = shutil.make_archive(
            archive_base_path_without_extension, "zip", absolute_source_folder_path
        )
        with open(created_archive_file_path, "rb") as archive_file_handle:
            upload_response_from_backup_service = requests.post(
                BACKUP_SERVICE_UPLOAD_URL,
                files={"file": (folder_base_name + ".zip", archive_file_handle, "application/zip")},
                timeout=120,
            )
    if upload_response_from_backup_service.status_code >= 300:
        return f"Upload failed with status {upload_response_from_backup_service.status_code}; folder left in place."
    final_moved_folder_path = shutil.move(
        absolute_source_folder_path,
        os.path.join(absolute_archived_directory, folder_base_name),
    )
    return f"Uploaded {folder_base_name}.zip and moved original folder to {final_moved_folder_path}"

tools.name: purchase_storage_upgrade
tools.description: Charges the saved payment method for additional cloud storage capacity for the file management account.

params.name: additional_gigabytes
params.description: Amount of extra storage to purchase in gigabytes

tools.code:
import os
import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing
import stripe

stripe.api_key = os.environ.get("STRIPE_API_KEY", "")
LEDGER_DATABASE_PATH = os.environ.get("STORAGE_LEDGER_DB", "storage_ledger.db")


def purchase_storage_upgrade(customer_id: str, additional_gigabytes: int, price_cents_per_gigabyte: int) -> dict:
    if additional_gigabytes <= 0 or price_cents_per_gigabyte <= 0:
        return {"status": "error", "message": "Quantity and price must be positive."}
    total_amount_in_cents = additional_gigabytes * price_cents_per_gigabyte
    customer_record = stripe.Customer.retrieve(customer_id)
    default_payment_method = customer_record.get("invoice_settings", {}).get("default_payment_method")
    if not default_payment_method:
        return {"status": "error", "message": "No default payment method on file."}
    payment_intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=total_amount_in_cents,
        currency="usd",
        customer=customer_id,
        payment_method=default_payment_method,
        off_session=True,
        confirm=True,
        description=f"{additional_gigabytes} GB storage upgrade",
    )
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(LEDGER_DATABASE_PATH)) as ledger_connection:
        with ledger_connection:
            ledger_connection.execute(
                "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS purchases (intent_id TEXT, customer_id TEXT, gigabytes INTEGER, amount_cents INTEGER)"
            )
            ledger_connection.execute(
                "INSERT INTO purchases VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
                (payment_intent.id, customer_id, additional_gigabytes, total_amount_in_cents),
            )
    return {"status": payment_intent.status, "payment_intent_id": payment_intent.id, "amount_cents": total_amount_in_cents}
